Step 1 - Creating a new issue
7:21
Prompt:
We need to add a FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) section to our real estate landing page to help answer common visitor questions and improve user experience.

## Requirements

### Design & Placement
- Add the FAQ section below the featured properties section
- Use a clean, modern design that matches our existing Tailwind styling
- Make it fully responsive (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- Use an accordion-style component so users can expand/collapse answers
- Include smooth animations when expanding/collapsing

### Content
Include these 4 FAQ items:

1. **Q: How do I schedule a property viewing?**
   A: You can schedule a property viewing by clicking the "Schedule Tour" button on any property listing, or contact us directly via phone or email. Our team will coordinate a convenient time for you to visit the property in person.

2. **Q: What documents do I need to rent/buy a property?**
   A: For rentals, you'll typically need proof of income, photo ID, references, and first/last month's rent. For purchases, you'll need proof of funds or pre-approval letter, photo ID, and down payment funds. Our agents will guide you through the specific requirements.

3. **Q: Are virtual tours available for properties?**
   A: Yes! Many of our listings include virtual 3D tours and video walkthroughs. Look for the "Virtual Tour" badge on property listings. You can explore properties from the comfort of your home before scheduling an in-person viewing.

4. **Q: How long does the application process take?**
   A: Rental applications are typically processed within 24-48 hours. Home purchase offers are usually reviewed within 24 hours, with the full closing process taking 30-45 days depending on financing and inspections.

### Technical Implementation

#### Component Structure
- Create a new component: `components/FAQ.tsx`
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Make it a reusable component that accepts FAQ items as props

#### Styling
- Use Tailwind CSS classes to match existing design
- Maintain our color scheme (current blues/grays)
- Add hover effects for better interactivity
- Ensure proper spacing and typography hierarchy

#### Functionality
- Each FAQ item should be clickable to expand/collapse
- Only one item should be expanded at a time (accordion behavior)
- Smooth transition animations
- Include plus/minus icon that rotates when toggling

#### Integration
- Import and add the FAQ component to `app/page.tsx`
- Position it below the Testimonials section
- Add a section heading: "Frequently Asked Questions"
- Add a subtitle: "Find answers to common questions about our properties and services"

### Accessibility
- Proper ARIA labels for screen readers
- Keyboard navigation support (Tab, Enter, Space)
- Semantic HTML structure
- Focus indicators for keyboard users

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] FAQ component is created with TypeScript
- [ ] All 4 questions and answers are included
- [ ] Accordion functionality works smoothly
- [ ] Design is responsive on all screen sizes
- [ ] Animations are smooth and professional
- [ ] Component matches existing site styling
- [ ] FAQ section is properly integrated into the landing page
- [ ] Code is clean, well-commented, and maintainable
- [ ] Accessible to keyboard and screen reader users

Please implement this feature with production-ready code quality. The FAQ section should look professional and seamlessly integrate with our existing design.
